product.title: Cortech Sequoia Durable Molded Wood Grain Behavioral Health Bed - 210
product.body_html:
The Cortech Sequoia Bed combines residential styling with molded durability for behavioral health settings. Seamless, safe, and easy to clean. The Sequoia Bed is a molded wood grain behavioral health bed that brings warmth and dignity to secure healthcare environments. Unlike traditional institutional beds, the Sequoia Bed offers a residential aesthetic while delivering the strength and safety behavioral health settings require. Because of its seamless molded construction, the Sequoia bed enhances infection control and reduces tampering risks.

  • Durable, one-piece molded design made from high impact “no break" polyethylene
  • Virtually maintenance free
  • Molded woodgrain finish and feel, resulting in exceptional appeal and cleanability. Designed for behavioral health and secure healthcare settings
  • Rounded edges and sloped surfaces mitigate ligature risk
  • Dimensions: 18H x 82L x 42W, weight 126 lbs
  • Options:
    • Bed can be bolted to the floor using concealed corner mounting system
    • Model 210S2 features 2 underside ballast doors used to add weight with sandbags and secured with tamper-resistant screws. (Do not use loose sand)
    • Model 210KIT - bolt-down hardware kit
    • Suggested mattress size: 6H x 80L x 36W
  • ISO 22196 tested showing a >99% reduction in bacteria
  • Seamless construction supports safety and cleanability
  • Inherently antimicrobial and easy to maintain
  • Flame retardant (passes CAL 133 and UL 94 HB)
  • GREENGUARD Gold Certified for low chemical emissions
  • Colors: Heritage Oak, Natural Oak, Coastal Driftwood, Walnut
  • Lifetime Warranty
  • Made in the USA to ISO Quality Standards

The one-piece molded polyethylene frame removes joints and exposed hardware that could be misused. The inherently antimicrobial surface resists moisture and wipes clean easily, which helps staff maintain hygienic spaces. The Sequoia Bed supports behavioral health mattress platforms and withstands the demands of high-acuity environments.

The molded wood grain finish allows facilities to create calming, human-centered spaces without sacrificing durability. As a result, the Sequoia Bed balances therapeutic design with long-term performance. It pairs seamlessly with other Sequoia case goods to support behavioral health hospitals and secure treatment centers.

Because behavioral health environments demand both safety and dignity, the Sequoia Bed supports patients and caregivers alike. Its molded construction, residential styling, and dependable performance make it a trusted solution for healing environments.

About the Cortech Sequoia Furniture Series:
The Sequoia Bed anchors Cortech's Sequoia Series, which earned a 2025 Gold Nightingale Award in the Anti-Ligature & Reduced-Ligature Furnishings category at the Healthcare Design Conference & Expo. In addition, the series includes coordinating nightstands designed to create cohesive behavioral health patient rooms.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
